prompt: At a stable in Cappadocia, the worker told (the riders / to close) the gate.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell в косвенном приказе сразу идёт дополнение без предлога to, а затем инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: Traffic was slow at a busy road in Mexico City. An officer ordered (us / to wait) behind the white line.
explanation_ru: Глагол order требует конструкции order + дополнение + to-инфинитив, без предлога to перед дополнением.

prompt: An older pupil warned me (not / to run) on the wet floor.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном инфинитиве частица not всегда ставится перед to: warned me not to run.

prompt: A key ring went missing, so the manager ___ the camera.
options: asked the guard check
asked to the guard to check
asked the guard to check
asked the guard that he check
explanation_ru: После ask в значении просьбы используется модель ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив. Ошибочно опускать to перед глаголом или ставить to перед дополнением.

prompt: Last Saturday we joined a tree-planting day in Kampala. Our group leader, Grace, explained how deep the holes needed to be. She asked (each volunteer / to pour) one full bucket of water onto each young tree. She also reminded us (not / to step) on the small roots and asked (we / to have) enough gloves.
explanation_ru: В просьбе и напоминании используется инфинитив с to (или not to), а в косвенном общем вопросе после asked нужны союз if/whether и прямой порядок слов со сдвигом времени.

prompt: My uncle told to us to put the heavy box on the carpet.
answer: My uncle told us to put the heavy box on the carpet.
accepted_answers: My uncle told us to put the heavy box on the carpet.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell дополнение идёт напрямую без предлога to: правильно told us to put, а не told to us.

prompt: During a busy shoot in Prague, the film director instructed (Jakub / to stand) beside the window and (not / to look) straight at the camera, but he kept smiling at the crew.
explanation_ru: После instruct используется дополнение и инфинитив с to, а в отрицательной части частица not ставится перед инфинитивом.

prompt: Did the cleaner ask (you / to return) your trays to the rack?
explanation_ru: В вопросе о просьбе сохраняется конструкция ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив: ask you to return.

prompt: Crowds gathered around a street stall in Seoul. The owner shouted, "Please step back while I lift this hot pot!" Which report is correct?
options: The owner asked everyone stepping back while he lifted the hot pot.
The owner told to everyone to step back while he lifted the hot pot.
The owner asked everyone to step back while he lifted the hot pot.
The owner said everyone to step back while he lifted the hot pot.
explanation_ru: Для передачи просьбы нужна модель ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив. Конструкции с -ing, told to и said everyone to грамматически неверны.

prompt: Halfway up a mountain path in Nepal, I felt dizzy and stopped at a small health post. The nurse checked my pulse and handed me a warm cup. She advised (me / to drink) slowly and asked (I / to feel) cold. Before I left, she warned me (not / to climb) higher if my headache returned.
explanation_ru: После advise и warn с дополнением ставится (not) to-инфинитив, а после asked в общем вопросе — союз if/whether с прямым порядком слов и сдвигом в прошедшее время.

prompt: Our Lisbon hostel notice warned guests (not / to leave) food by the window. Sofia laughed until a seagull stole it.
explanation_ru: Запрет или предупреждение после warn передаётся формой not to + глагол, где not предшествует to.

prompt: "Play the final line more softly, Callum," the music teacher said. → The music teacher asked Callum …
answer: The music teacher asked Callum to play the final line more softly.
accepted_answers: The music teacher asked Callum to play the final line more softly.
explanation_ru: Повелительное наклонение в косвенной просьбе заменяется на инфинитив с частицей to после дополнения.

prompt: Before PE, our teacher asked (the class / to line up) by the bench.
explanation_ru: После ask с адресатом ставится прямое дополнение и инфинитив с to: asked the class to line up.

prompt: Working at a weather station in northern Norway was exciting but freezing. On my first morning, the chief, Henrik, explained how the snow tools worked. He (to order / me / to check) the snow stick outside and (to write) the number in the book. He also warned me (not / to forget) my thick gloves, because cold metal can hurt bare skin.
explanation_ru: Приказы и предупреждения в прошлом передаются через ordered/warned + дополнение + (not) to-инфинитив; во втором однородном инфинитиве после and частицу to можно сохранить или опустить.

prompt: In the Budapest shop, the boss (to tell / Eszter / to wrap) the glasses carefully.
explanation_ru: Указание в прошедшем времени строится по модели told + дополнение (без предлога) + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Moments before the match in Cairo, the referee called the captains over. He ___ the game friendly.
options: told them keep
told them to keep
said them to keep
told to them to keep
explanation_ru: Правильная модель — tell + дополнение + to-инфинитив. Глагол say не употребляется в конструкции said them to, а после tell не нужен предлог to перед дополнением.

prompt: Midway through the final online round in Berlin, our captain asked Felix that he mute his microphone.
answer: Midway through the final online round in Berlin, our captain asked Felix to mute his microphone.
accepted_answers: Midway through the final online round in Berlin, our captain asked Felix to mute his microphone.
explanation_ru: Просьба после ask с дополнением передаётся через to-инфинитив (asked Felix to mute), а не через придаточное предложение с that.

prompt: At Tallinn passport control, the officer (to ask / him / to take) off his hat.
explanation_ru: Вежливое требование в прошедшем времени оформляется как asked + дополнение + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Min-jun missed the first deadline in Seoul. His professor reminded (him / to hand in) the essay before Friday morning.
explanation_ru: Глагол remind в значении напоминания о действии требует дополнения и инфинитива с частицей to.

prompt: We set up our tent in a forest park in Canada. Wild bears sometimes walk near the camp at night. A park ranger (to tell / us / to put) all our food in a metal box. He also warned us (not / to keep) any snacks inside the tent.
explanation_ru: Утвердительное указание передаётся через told + дополнение + to-инфинитив, а отрицательное предупреждение — через warned + дополнение + not to-инфинитив.

prompt: Sea turtles were nesting along the beach in Costa Rica, and our dog kept running towards the sand dunes. A lifeguard rushed over and ___ near the nests.
options: warned us not to take the dog
warned us to not take the dog
warned to us not take the dog
warned us don't take the dog
explanation_ru: После warn дополнение ставится без предлога to, а отрицание образуется порядком слов not to + глагол. Варианты to not и don't в косвенной речи ошибочны.

prompt: A local cyclist slowed down by the Amsterdam canal. She warned (the runner / to watch out) for a loose stone.
explanation_ru: После глагола warn указывается адресат без предлога, а затем инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: Dark storm clouds were gathering over the bay in the Philippines. An old fisherman urged (Mateo / not / to sail) out and advised him (to tie) the small boat tighter.
explanation_ru: Оба глагола — urge и advise — с дополнением требуют (not) to-инфинитива; при отрицании not всегда идёт перед to.

prompt: My grandfather warned me to check the old oven door before opening it.
answer: My grandfather warned me to check the old oven door before opening it.
accepted_answers: My grandfather warned me to check the old oven door before opening it.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после глагола warn верно использованы прямое дополнение me и инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: Backstage at a film studio in Mumbai, Rohan looked nervous before his final scene. The makeup artist finished her work and stepped back to check the light. She begged (the actor / not / to touch) his face before the cameras rolled. Then she asked (he / to need) a glass of water and advised him (to sit) still.
explanation_ru: Глаголы beg и advise с дополнением требуют (not) to-инфинитива, тогда как после asked в общем вопросе нужен союз if/whether и прошедшее время.

prompt: Inside a Birmingham curry house, the chef told Priya, "Don't order the extra-hot sauce." Which report fits?
options: The chef warned Priya to not order the extra-hot sauce.
The chef warned Priya not to order the extra-hot sauce.
The chef warned Priya not order the extra-hot sauce.
The chef warned to Priya not to order the extra-hot sauce.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное предупреждение строится по схеме warn + дополнение без предлога + not to + глагол. Частица not должна стоять перед to.

prompt: Long tables filled the French village square. The host reminded (the guests / not / to place) glasses near the edge.
explanation_ru: После remind ставится дополнение, а для запрета используется порядок слов not to + инфинитив.

prompt: Standing at a pharmacy counter in Buenos Aires, Elena listened carefully to the instructions for her eye drops. The bottle was tiny, and the label was hard to read without glasses. The pharmacist advised (Elena / to store) the drops in the fridge and warned her (not / to share) them with anyone. He also (to offer / to print) the rules in larger letters for her.
explanation_ru: После advise и warn требуется дополнение + (not) to-инфинитив, а глагол offer в значении предложения помощи соединяется с to-инфинитивом напрямую без дополнения.

prompt: Monkeys near our Nepal lodge loved stealing shoes. Our guide ___ our wet boots outside.
options: warned us not leaving
warned us to not leave
warned us that not leave
warned us not to leave
explanation_ru: После warn с дополнением нужен инфинитив с to, а отрицание ставится перед to: warned us not to leave.

prompt: In Brussels, Amir felt confident before his first job interview. Still, his career adviser reminded (the graduate / not / to arrive) late and encouraged him (to prepare) two questions about the company.
explanation_ru: Глаголы remind и encourage требуют модели «дополнение + (not) to-инфинитив», где not стоит перед частицей to.

prompt: Everybody in the Nairobi chemistry class was watching the experiment closely. Zuri looked nervous as she picked up the glass bottle. The teacher told (her / to pour) the blue liquid slowly into the bowl. Then he warned her (not / to shake) the jar and asked (the table / to be) completely dry.
explanation_ru: Команды и предостережения после tell и warn оформляются через (not) to-инфинитив, а косвенный общий вопрос после asked вводится союзом if/whether с глаголом в прошедшем времени.

prompt: Although Lukas planned a long walk in Ljubljana, the shopkeeper advised him keep the cheese in the fridge.
answer: Although Lukas planned a long walk in Ljubljana, the shopkeeper advised him to keep the cheese in the fridge.
accepted_answers: Although Lukas planned a long walk in Ljubljana, the shopkeeper advised him to keep the cheese in the fridge.
explanation_ru: После advise с дополнением нельзя опускать частицу to перед инфинитивом: правильно advised him to keep.

prompt: Because the water was only one metre deep, the Australian lifeguard warned Liam (not / to dive) at the shallow end.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное предупреждение после warn + дополнение строится с помощью not to + инфинитив.

prompt: Several student accounts were hacked at the Chicago library last month. A notice on the screen reminds users (not / to share) their passwords and advises them (to log out) before leaving.
explanation_ru: Глаголы remind и advise с дополнением требуют (not) to-инфинитива независимо от того, стоят они в настоящем или прошедшем времени.

prompt: The bus could not pass, so the worker ___ my car.
options: asked me move
asked me to move
asked to me move
said me to move
explanation_ru: Просьба передаётся через ask + дополнение без предлога + to-инфинитив. Глагол say в этой конструкции не используется.

prompt: Waves hit our small ferry between two islands in Croatia. The wind was strong, and the deck got very wet. A sailor told (passengers / to hold) the metal rail tightly. He also advised us (not / to stand) near the open door.
explanation_ru: После tell и advise с дополнением используется инфинитив с to, а в отрицательной форме частица not ставится перед to.

prompt: Our Prague flat has a broken oven. I warned Tereza (not / to turn) it on because it fills the kitchen with smoke.
explanation_ru: Запрет после warn + дополнение выражается конструкцией not to + глагол.

prompt: When Mads's car broke down on a desert road near Alice Springs, a local mechanic phoned him and said, "Stay by your car and don't walk for help in the midday heat." Which report fits best?
options: The mechanic advised Mads staying by his car and not to walk for help in the midday heat.
The mechanic warned Mads to stay by his car and to not walk for help in the midday heat.
The mechanic told to Mads to stay by his car and not to walk for help in the midday heat.
The mechanic urged Mads to stay by his car and not to walk for help in the midday heat.
explanation_ru: Глагол urge требует прямого дополнения без предлога to, далее инфинитива с to и отрицания not to. В остальных вариантах есть ошибки: staying после дополнения, to not и told to.

prompt: Seeing how unstable the tall pile looked in the Rotterdam warehouse, the senior worker warned Bram to not stack any boxes above the red line.
answer: Seeing how unstable the tall pile looked in the Rotterdam warehouse, the senior worker warned Bram not to stack any boxes above the red line.
accepted_answers: Seeing how unstable the tall pile looked in the Rotterdam warehouse, the senior worker warned Bram not to stack any boxes above the red line.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном инфинитиве частица not всегда стоит перед to: правильно warned Bram not to stack, а не to not stack.

prompt: Visiting her uncle's farm in Bavaria was Klara's favourite part of the autumn break. Before breakfast, the farmer handed her a small basket of grain and smiled. He invited (Klara / to feed) the hens with him and asked (she / to want) to collect the fresh eggs afterwards. Before they stepped outside, her aunt reminded her (to wear) rubber boots because the yard was muddy.
explanation_ru: После invite и remind с дополнением используется to-инфинитив, а после asked в общем вопросе ставятся союз if/whether и глагол в прошедшем времени.

prompt: Two students left their backpacks on the library stairs in Dublin, and the guard told them, "Move your bags off the steps right away so people can pass." → The security guard ordered the students …
answer: The security guard ordered the students to move their bags off the steps right away so people could pass.
accepted_answers: The security guard ordered the students to move their bags off the steps right away so people could pass.
The security guard ordered the students to move their bags off the steps immediately so people could pass.
The security guard ordered the students to move their bags off the steps right away so that people could pass.
The security guard ordered the students to move their bags off the steps immediately so that people could pass.
explanation_ru: Приказ передаётся через order + дополнение + to-инфинитив, местоимение your меняется на their, а глагол can сдвигается в could.

prompt: Chaos broke out in the Dubai hotel kitchen when two tour groups arrived early. The head chef ___ the onions immediately and put the soup on low heat.
options: ordered to Tariq to chop
said Tariq to chop
ordered Tariq that he chop
ordered Tariq to chop
explanation_ru: Глагол order требует прямого дополнения без предлога to и инфинитива с частицей to: ordered Tariq to chop. Варианты с ordered to, said и that he здесь ошибочны.
